## Summary

This PR adds the `abuzucom/foucault` PR security review to euler. `.github/workflows/security-review-pr.yml` runs after `ci` completes. The workflow pins foucault v3.3.14 at `06d74fba4d9013654cdaf9896bb7535724385186`.

## Wiring

Foucault's reusable workflow runs its adapter from fixed `ci/` paths in the caller checkout. Euler's quality adapter occupies `ci/build_pr_case.py` and `ci/call_model.py`. The new workflow mirrors foucault's caller and reusable job steps instead. Every foucault script runs from the pinned `.foucault/` checkout. No foucault file is copied. Euler's `ci/` stays unchanged.

The workflow differs from the upstream files in these lines only:

- `.foucault/` prefixes on the adapter and validator paths
- `FOUCAULT_REF` in place of the `audit_ref` input
- resolved PR metadata from the `resolve-pr` job in place of reusable inputs
- a fixed `MODEL_CALL_COMMAND`, `FAIL_ON_BLOCK`, and PR comment
- `OLLAMA_API_KEY` mapped to `MODEL_API_KEY`

## Changes

- `.github/workflows/security-review-pr.yml` (new)
- `docs/pr-security-review.md` (new)
- `README.md`, `adopters/README.md`, and the `AGENTS.md` orientation reference the new workflow.
- `CHANGELOG.md` advances to 0.2.0.
- `Makefile` adds the new document to the prose checks.

## Verification

- All workflows parse as YAML.
- `check_code_quality.py unpinned` and `suppressed-checks` report no findings on `.github/`.
- Both checkouts set `persist-credentials: false`.
- No `run:` or `script:` body holds a `${{ }}` expression.
- `run_model_command.parse_command("python3 ci/call_model.py")` resolves inside a `.foucault/` copy of the pinned commit.
- The pinned `check_pr_review_response.py` accepts a sample APPROVE report.
- `make check` passes locally.

## Gaps

- No live run happened. The workflow needs the `OLLAMA_API_KEY` repository secret.
- `workflow_run` triggers only from the default branch. The security review starts on pull requests after this PR merges.
- Foucault's `adopters/` directory holds no euler record yet. That change belongs to the foucault repository.

pulls.body:
## Summary

This PR turns euler into a code quality and conventions review system. The design takes its concepts from `abuzucom/foucault`. No foucault file is copied. The rules come from a reviewed subset of the `abuzucom/vibe-check` list plus approved additions.

## Commits

The change spans 141 new or changed files. Most of them are eval fixtures. The work sits in one PR by approval. Each commit covers one phase:

1. `docs: import tailored AGENTS.md policy text` imports the `abuzucom/agents` policy text at `5b90aec`. Tooling paths from the upstream text give way to the Rule 13 limitation statement.
2. `feat: add QUALITY.md review contract and checker` adds `QUALITY.md` with 41 classes in four tiers, `scripts/check_quality_policy.py`, the `Makefile`, and the `ci` workflow.
3. `feat: add deterministic quality checkers` adds `scripts/check_code_quality.py` for 17 classes with heuristic coverage.
4. `test: add eval corpus and runner` adds 38 golden cases and `eval/run_eval.py`.
5. `feat: add PR quality review workflow` adds the `ci/` adapter, the reusable `quality-review` workflow, the `quality-review-pr` caller, and the policy diff report.

## Verification

- `make check` passes locally. The target runs the policy and prose checks, the self-scan, the eval structure check, and 141 unit tests.
- The `ci` workflow passes on the head commit.
- The self-scan reports no blocking finding. One M18 warning remains on the endpoint allowlist in `ci/call_model.py`. The allowlist needs literal URLs.
- `QUALITY.md` measures 16,590 bytes against the 32 KiB cap.
- A dry run of `ci/build_pr_case.py` on this branch produced two chunks and seven prescan candidates.

## Gaps

- No live model run happened. The session holds no provider key.
- The `quality-review-pr` caller needs the `OLLAMA_API_KEY` repository secret.
- `workflow_run` triggers only from the default branch. The review starts on pull requests after this PR merges.

## Rule 13 check proposals

The following `AGENTS.md` rules are mechanically checkable but have no euler check yet:

- ASCII and prose dashes outside the checked documents
- branch names
- commit messages
- `persist-credentials: false` on checkouts
- action pins to full SHAs
- CHANGELOG version advance
- banned-agent authorship
